scenario.zh: 金融机构输入交易者心理特征，获得其在新市场情景下的决策倾向预测
scenario.en: Financial institutions input trader psychological traits and receive predicted decision tendencies in unfamiliar market scenarios

instruction.zh: 选择一组交易者特征，查看模型如何描述其在市场压力下的决策倾向
instruction.en: Choose a trader trait profile to see how the model describes decision tendencies under market stress

output.zh: 预测倾向：早于理性预期平仓，回避未知波动
output.en: Predicted tendency: exits earlier than rational baseline, avoids unfamiliar volatility

input.zh: 损失厌恶：强 | 时间压力敏感性：中 | 群体心理跟随：低
input.en: Loss aversion: Strong | Time pressure sensitivity: Medium | Herding tendency: Low

output.zh: 亏损扩大时倾向快速止损 | 对新波动情景反应保守 | 较少跟随市场整体方向
output.en: Tends to stop-loss quickly when losses grow | Reacts conservatively to unfamiliar volatility | Less likely to follow broad market direction

output.zh: 预测倾向：在恐慌期间跟随多数参与者行动，决策速度加快
output.en: Predicted tendency: follows majority participants during panic, decision speed increases

input.zh: 损失厌恶：中 | 时间压力敏感性：高 | 群体心理跟随：强
input.en: Loss aversion: Medium | Time pressure sensitivity: High | Herding tendency: Strong

output.zh: 恐慌期间倾向跟随大多数参与者平仓 | 在截止时限临近时决策速度显著加快 | 较少独立评估基本面
output.en: Tends to liquidate following majority during panic | Decision speed rises sharply near deadlines | Less likely to independently assess fundamentals

output.zh: 预测倾向：在不利行情中持仓更久，寻找逆向机会
output.en: Predicted tendency: holds positions longer in adverse conditions, seeks contrarian opportunities

input.zh: 损失厌恶：弱 | 时间压力敏感性：低 | 群体心理跟随：弱
input.en: Loss aversion: Weak | Time pressure sensitivity: Low | Herding tendency: Weak

output.zh: 倾向在下跌中持仓等待反弹 | 对时间截止敏感度低，可能承担强平风险 | 倾向逆势操作
output.en: Tends to hold through drawdowns waiting for recovery | Low sensitivity to deadlines, may risk forced liquidation | Inclines toward contrarian moves

instruction.zh: 选择经纪商如何使用这种决策倾向预测来管理风险
instruction.en: Select how a broker applies decision tendency predictions to manage risk

output.zh: 根据预测的平仓倾向提前安排流动性缓冲
output.en: Pre-arranges liquidity buffers based on predicted liquidation tendencies

input.zh: 市场波动上升，经纪商需预判客户平仓行为
input.en: Market volatility rises, broker needs to anticipate client liquidation behavior

output.zh: 按预测倾向对客户分层，高风险优先关注
output.en: Clients are tiered by predicted tendency, high-risk clients prioritized

detail.zh: 将强损失厌恶与高时间敏感度客户标记为优先监控对象
detail.en: Flag clients with strong loss aversion and high time sensitivity for priority monitoring

detail.zh: 根据预测的平仓规模提前安排资金，避免流动性缺口
detail.en: Arrange capital in advance based on predicted liquidation volume to avoid gaps

detail.zh: 随市场变化更新预测，同步调整经纪商对冲敞口
detail.en: Update predictions as market shifts, adjust broker hedge exposure accordingly

output.zh: 依据个人决策倾向调整保证金系数，减少过度资本占用
output.en: Adjusts margin coefficients by individual decision tendency to reduce excess capital requirements

input_label.zh: 两类交易者的保证金场景
input_label.en: Margin scenario for two trader types

input.zh: 交易者A：强损失厌恶，历史上主动止损 | 交易者B：弱损失厌恶，历史上持仓至强平
input.en: Trader A: Strong loss aversion, historically exits proactively | Trader B: Weak loss aversion, historically holds to forced liquidation

output.zh: 交易者A：建议下调保证金系数，风险可控 | 交易者B：建议维持或上调保证金系数，防范强平风险
output.en: Trader A: Suggested lower margin coefficient, risk is manageable | Trader B: Suggested maintain or raise coefficient to guard against forced liquidation

takeaway.zh: 此示例展示了心理特征如何映射到决策倾向预测；具体模型性能、实施方式和支持行业需在 42AI 官网核实，所有示例为虚构说明，非真实系统输出
takeaway.en: This example illustrates how psychological traits map to decision tendency predictions; actual model performance, implementation details, and supported industries require verification at 42AI's site — all examples are fictional illustrations, not real system output
